svg.title: RV32I-Subset Five-Stage Pipeline: IF, ID, EX, MEM, WB
svg.desc: Five stage blocks IF, ID, EX, MEM and WB in one row, separated by the IF/ID, ID/EX, EX/MEM and MEM/WB pipeline registers. Above the row: dashed blue forwarding paths from EX/MEM (2'b10, priority) and MEM/WB (2'b01) back to EX; dashed red Hazard Unit paths (load-use stall only) that hold PC and IF/ID and flush ID/EX; below the row, dashed orange Pipeline Control paths driven by branch_taken that redirect PC and flush IF/ID and ID/EX on a taken BEQ. Three numbered panels below explain forwarding, the one-bubble load-use stall, and the taken BEQ.

rdf:Description.dc:title: pipeline.svg
rdf:Description.dc:description: Five-stage pipeline overview for an educational SystemVerilog RV32I-subset processor with forwarding, load-use stall and EX-stage BEQ resolution.

svg.text: IF, ID, EX, MEM, WB with forwarding, a one-bubble load-use stall, and BEQ resolved in EX
Pipeline Control: a taken BEQ loads PC with id_ex_pc + id_ex_immediate and flushes IF/ID and ID/EX
Numbered callouts match the panels below.

g.text: Store-data forwarding is supported: SW receives
the newest rs2 value before the MEM stage.
Load data is never forwarded from EX/MEM.
Trigger: LW followed by an instruction that reads its rd.
Branch resolves in EX (ALU subtract, zero flag).
Driven by branch_taken, not by the Hazard Unit.
Not taken: the sequential PC + 4 continues.
